>sit on toilet / You are now seated on the toilet. /   / >stand up / You are on your own feet again. /   / >sit on sink / This isn't the kind of thing to sit on! /   / >

notes: Three distinct carriers confirmed via SIT ON X / STAND UP: bed 211 (guest room and George's bedroom share this one object), toilet 209 (George's Bathroom), four-poster bed 34 (Master Bedroom). Negatives: SIT ON CHAIR and SIT ON SINK 'This isn't the kind of thing to sit on!'. IMPORTANT: ENTER BED is refused ('You hit your head against the bed') and EXIT does not leave; only SIT ON / STAND UP work, so an 'Enter' offer is the wrong verb in Deadline -> offer Sit on/Stand up. bathtub 105 and sofa 200 not tested.
method: headless Chromium play.html, Input.Inject ordinary commands, ~1.3s wait; parent via ZRamReader.objectLinks(ZRamProvider.getMem(), WorldModel.lastPayload.playerId). reply = last 10 BufferLines after the command (may include preceding turn text).
